name: Guild Apprentice: Striking
description: You swept the Striking room and copied diagrams.  You have the first practice rank and a little Lore.  You were not attuned.

name: Meadow bred
description: You grew up on the arrival meadows, among tea, chalk, and gates that hummed and did nothing.

name: Drowned bred
description: You grew up on stilts over brown water.  You can swim, and you still carry a skin that does not leak.

name: Fungal bred
description: You grew up under caps and spores.  A mask was ordinary clothing.  You know which glow is safe to bottle.

name: Root bred
description: You grew up in root country, lamp in one hand and a haft in the other.  Dark tunnels do not surprise you.

name: Fallow bred
description: You grew up on tired fields, burning the stubble and stretching rations.  You can feed yourself from little.

name: Tallgrass bred
description: You grew up in grass over your head.  You learned to move in it, and to throw, because a bow was a luxury.

name: Hedge lore
description: Someone left you an almanac and made you read it aloud.  You know the slow rites exist.  You were never attuned.

name: Rune-scratcher
description: You can cut a blank, and you know a rune is a spell made still.  You have never set one into gear.

name: Tide-born
description: You were born in a pocket that was not Earth.  The tide has been weather to you since before you had the words.

name: Delver's child
description: A parent walked gates for pay.  You inherited chalk, a ration habit, and the sense to mark a way back.

name: Gate-sick
description: A crossing went badly and the sickness stayed.  You are slower, and you do not pretend otherwise.

name: Guild clerk
description: You kept the hall's books: who was attuned, who owed a rite, which primer was out.  You can talk, and you can read.

name: Caravan-born
description: You were born on a dry road between wells, Hollow shade one season and Sere sun the next.  You travel light.

name: Lighthouse-raised
description: You grew up in a Tidal light, counting the water over the road.  You swim, and you trust a lamp more than a story.

name: Ash-born
description: You were a child of Ember's warm stone.  You know coal, emberstone, and a forge that never quite goes out.

name: Barrow-child
description: You were raised near Pale barrows.  Salt and quiet were manners.  You do not have the Hexing rite.

name: Bough-born
description: You were born up in the Canopy, where a missed step is a long lesson.  You still like a staff in your hand.

name: Chalk walker
description: You marked paths before you could read a proper map.  The chalk rite is yours.  The hall has not attuned you.

name: Kiln watcher
description: You watched an Ember kiln and learned the first Striking practice.  They did not trust you with a rod.

name: Salt scribe
description: You copied ward-circles in salt for people who could cast them.  You have the practice rank, not the rite.
